remarks: Welcome to Saugatuck Shores! Location, Location, Location! Enjoy this cozy, charming, remodeled 2 beds/2 baths home in the amazing community near Saugatuck Harbor. Cute, comfortable, and remodeled Westport Charmmer with great natural light thanks to large windows and doors, a functional and entertaining open floor plan with a large kitchen, an airy dining area, and a large living room. Primary bedroom suite, 2nd bedroom/den/office, main bathroom, sleeping loft. Many new fixtures, updated kitchen and baths, modern mini-split units for air-conditioning, hardwood floors, vaulted ceilings and skylights make this a spacious home! Outside, you find a lovely, fully fenced backyard with a deck for entertainment and grilling. 3-car driveway parking. Less than 2 miles from Westport Center, Longshore Park (Golf/pool/tennis/marina), Compo Beach, Arts, Train, Levitt Pavilion, 2 Yacht Clubs. 55 miles from NYC. Ask about pets.
